about: Closed issue threads of the dVRK repositories in which a maintainer's reply states the cause, labelled by hand for task 04. Only the thread id, the class and a one-line reason in the labeller's own words are stored; the thread text is read from the local corpus. One labeller, not a dVRK maintainer.

classes.software_defect: a bug in the dVRK software, corrected by a change to the code
classes.version_mismatch: the user combined versions, branches or file formats that do not belong together
classes.configuration: the site's own configuration file is wrong or lacks an entry
classes.hardware: a physical cause: a connection, a cable, cooling, a board
classes.environment: the computer around the dVRK software: drivers, operating-system packages, network names
classes.documentation: the documentation gave a command or a name that is wrong
classes.unsupported: what the user tried is not supported by this version of the software or firmware

threads: development branch needs the matching branches of its dependencies
known bug in the jaw command, fixed in a release
message printed late; fixed by a commit
calibration utility broken by an update; fixed by a commit
uninitialised desired positions; fixed in the controller code
a file was modified by accident before a release
the console file lacked the camera-arm teleoperation entry
that generation of arm was not supported at the time
configuration files of an old format version used with new software
the connection type asked about is not stable in that firmware
no data link between arm and controller
the documented launch command lacked a file suffix
a regression in jaw limits, fixed on the development branch
the controller boards had no heat sinks
the base frames of the hand controllers were wrong in the system file
vector size mismatch after an internal change
host names not resolvable between the two computers
the packaged video component used an old media library
the frame grabber's driver library was missing
a script not ready for Python 3, fixed on the development branch
